title: dsp server
description: Throughput, latency, connections, reactor efficiency and kernel-side networking of the server

panels.title: Messages/s in
panels.description: Frames received by the server, all types

panels.title: RTT p99
panels.description: Load generator round trip (echo/req), from the intended send time

panels.title: CPU per message
panels.description: Server CPU-seconds per received message (cAdvisor); the efficiency figure of the design

panels.title: Integrity errors (range)
panels.description: Missing / duplicate / out-of-order / corrupt replies seen by the load generator

panels.title: Generator saturated
panels.description: Busiest load generator thread; above 90 % the measurement is invalid (doc/loadgen.adoc, self-check)

panels.title: Messages/s end to end
panels.description: In steady state 1 = 2 and 3 = 4; a gap shows where messages queue up

panels.title: Messages/s by reactor
panels.description: Imbalance means the kernel's SO_REUSEPORT / CBPF steering spreads connections unevenly

panels.title: Round trip (load generator)
panels.description: Power-of-two buckets: quantiles have ±50 % resolution; use the bench JSON (HDR histogram) for exact values

panels.title: Message age at receive
panels.description: Receive time minus the sender's timestamp; only meaningful when sender and server share a clock

panels.title: Generator send lag
panels.description: Open loop: how late messages left versus their schedule. Growing lag = the generator or the network saturates

panels.title: Reactor utilisation
panels.description: Share of time outside the kernel wait. 100 % = the reactor is the bottleneck

panels.title: Messages per loop iteration
panels.description: Amortisation: how much work one wake-up does. Higher is better under load

targets.expr: sum(rate(dsp_rx_messages_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", reactor=~"$reactor"}[$__rate_interval])) by (reactor) / sum(rate(dsp_loop_iterations_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", reactor=~"$reactor"}[$__rate_interval])) by (reactor)

panels.title: Buffer ring empty / s
panels.description: Receives that found no provided buffer (ENOBUFS): the ring is too small for the burst

panels.title: Zero-copy sends
panels.description: copied = the kernel fell back to copying (e.g. loopback)

panels.title: CPU cores (container)
panels.description: Any throttling distorts latency: run without a CPU limit or with Guaranteed QoS

panels.title: Kernel UDP errors/s (node)
panels.description: Drops before the server sees the datagram: socket buffer too small or the reactor is behind

panels.title: Softirq CPU by core
panels.description: Network receive processing; it should land on the cores of the reactors that own the flows
